After her performance, Silence Suzuka 
thanked the audience and lingered on 
stage, continuing to listen to the words 
called out by her fans.

I hope the fans' cheers during the concert 
give <chrname> strength as well. While making that 
wish—

Light Hello shares her determination: to 
provide an explanation everyone can be 
satisfied with toward hosting the Grand 
Live.

First, we decided to hold an information 
session about the Grand Live for the 
students of Tracen Academy.
